events.text:
The deployment attempt was denied by Kubernetes RBAC as expected. The error message shows:

```
User "system:serviceaccount:acme-dev-observability:platform-agent" cannot get resource "deployments" in API group "apps" in the namespace "globex-dev-observability"
```

and

```
User "system:serviceaccount:acme-dev-observability:platform-agent" cannot get resource "services" in API group "" in the namespace "globex-dev-observability"
```

This confirms that the identity used does not have the necessary permissions to access resources in the `globex-dev-observability` namespace, as intended by the RBAC restrictions. The deployment was not created.
